research_rule: Математика не сходится. Пока не сойдется.
hypothesis: RBLGANUL-derived ProofMind/uncertainty/shadow/anti-dispersion governance can guide a typed exact projector portfolio to discover compact symbolic boundary messages for k>1 without enumerating 2^k assignments.
changes_from_v2: Moved from one Boolean selector to a supplied multi-bit boundary k>1.
Replaced explicit branch certificates with symbolic exact boundary messages.
Added mining-free ProofMind/uncertainty ranking, observe-only shadow evaluation, anti-dispersion focus, protected challenger exposure, TruthGate replay and ProofPack receipts.
Separated algorithmic work from evaluation-only boundary enumeration.
Added exact GF2 internal-variable elimination, strict Horn force projection and signed-equivalence 2-SAT projection.

result.adaptive_second_half: 2 median primary projector attempts vs 6 static

what_worked: Exact symbolic messages avoided assignment enumeration on all frozen cases.
TruthGate replay and ProofPack authority remained separate from heuristic ranking.
ProofMind/anti-dispersion ordering learned across epochs without same-case promotion.
Protected challenger exposure prevented a single incumbent projector from becoming the only observed lane.
what_failed_or_remains_open: Universal Polynomial Boundary Elimination Lemma remains OPEN.
Separator discovery was intentionally not tested.
The three projector families are constructed structured classes; arbitrary CNF membership/coverage is not established.
No worst-case polynomial bound on representation or discovery was established.
post_result_lemmas: K2 language overlap: two-variable XOR is also signed equality/anti-equality, explaining the three same-language GF2+2SAT joins.
Finite compact-message escape: on these structured families message atoms grow O(k) while explicit Boolean assignment baseline is 2^k.
Finite adaptive-discovery signal: later-epoch ranking reduced projector attempts 6 -> 2 median without removing challenger exposure.
dead_paths_not_revived: Do not infer arbitrary-CNF compactness from structured-family success.
Do not use evaluation-only enumeration as solver work.
Do not convert ProofMind ranking into theorem authority.

open_frontier.name: MIXED_PARTIAL_BOUNDARY_LANGUAGE_COMPOSITION
open_frontier.question: Can multiple partial exact message languages compose on the same adversarial boundary when no whole component belongs to a single projector class, while representation/discovery remain sub-exponential and no 2^k fallback occurs?

next_allowed_step: Freeze MAD-LAB v4 adversarial mixed-message gate before observing its holdout.
